name: isHybridBackupDestinationConfigured
definition: At least one IDrive backup plan backs up to both a cloud and a local destination (backup_details.where_to_backup contains CLOUD and LOCAL).
evidenceRequiredForTrue: at least one plan whose where_to_backup lists both CLOUD and LOCAL

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the key stops being grandfathered by the allowlist; proposed, single emitter, definition taken from the emitting transform.

notes: The file returns False, not null, when the plan list is empty.
